description: Create Aeronautics/Sable compatibility fixes for Mekanism blocks on mounted contraptions.

mods.name: Create Aeronautics: Mekanism Compatibility
mods.description: Adds Create Aeronautics/Sable support for Mekanism Teleporters, Dimensional Stabilizers, transmitters, Wind Generators, Digital Miners, Lasers, and machine sounds on mounted contraptions. Integrations are enabled by default.

releases.notes:
- Fix mounted Mekanism portable teleporter targeting/tracking for Sable sublevels.
- Fix mounted Mekanism transmitter, tank, cable, and pipe visual state sync after Sable assembly and toggling.
- Keep Digital Miner, Dimensional Stabilizer, Wind Generator, lasers, and machine sounds Sable-aware.
- Remove Create/Aeronautics hard metadata dependencies; Sable remains required.
- Remove internal debug/GameTest harness from production builds.
